comment: Limits of docs/architecture/m1-build-spec.md section 9, read by tools/perf_map.gd. class: cpu = the fill, swap and rebuild times (CPU side, fail the run), mem = memory (fails the run), gpu = frame times (fail only with --gpu-limits, on real hardware). Never read by a GUT test.

frame_worst_ms.what: worst frame at any zoom while panning

frame_mean_ms.what: mean frame at any zoom while panning

fill_first_ms.what: fill: CPU time until the screen at the camera (zoom 0.5, about 1,000 hexes) is in

fill_all_ms.what: whole map filled, CPU time of the slices (5 ms a frame)

fill_frame_worst_ms.what: worst frame while the fill runs (slice + what the engine builds + drawing)

build_action_ms.what: one build: MapCells.of_hex and set_tile for the touched hexes, worst of the samples

season_swap_ms.what: swap to a season that was requested ahead: load_season and the swap of the chunks on the screen at zoom 1, worst

season_swap_frame_worst_ms.what: worst frame of a whole swap (the rest of the map goes 5 ms a frame)

chunk_rebuild_ms.what: EdgeLines.for_chunk and set_chunk_lines for one chunk, worst

cells_static_mb.what: static memory of the filled cells

video_mb_per_season.what: video memory of one season's TileSet (the standard's budget for the map)

owner_frame_worst_ms.what: M2: worst frame panning at zooms 2, 1, 0.5, 0.25, 0.12 in Owner mode with borders and names on

mode_switch_ms.what: M2: set_mode to the next frame, worst of four switches

borders_all_ms.what: M2: every border chunk built, total CPU of the 5 ms slices

border_chunk_ms.what: M2: one chunk's BorderLines.for_chunk and mesh, worst

owner_change_frame_ms.what: M2: Territory.transfer of 1 hex: drained, texel written, touched chunks rebuilt, the two countries' names, to the next frame; worst of 24

owner_change_200_ms.what: M2: a transfer of 200 hexes (a peace treaty): all the work, total CPU; the chunks are sliced

country_names_ms.what: M2: CountryNames.places_of for the largest country

scenario_grow_ms.what: M2: ScenarioGrowth.grow on the whole map (the tool and the editor, not play)

owner_mem_mb.what: M2: overlay textures and border meshes

parchment_build_ms.what: parchment: made-up Europe, ParchmentShape and the chunk meshes, total CPU of the 5 ms slices

parchment_build_ni_ms.what: parchment: north Italy's geometry at once, worst of 3

parchment_slice_worst_ms.what: parchment: worst frame while the made-up Europe builds

parchment_goods_bytes_ms.what: parchment: ParchmentView.goods_bytes for the whole made-up Europe, cold, worst of 3

parchment_good_switch_ms.what: parchment: set_good plus legend and icon layout to the next frame at zoom 0.30 (Goods), worst of 8; temporary limit until #485 (planned 2)

parchment_owner_change_ms.what: parchment: a 1-hex transfer with the parchment solid (Owner, the zoom-out limit): texel, owner_bytes, names laid out, to the next frame; worst of 24; temporary limit until #485 (planned 16)

parchment_labels_ms.what: parchment: ParchmentLabels.relayout for one view change on the made-up Europe, 1920 x 1080, at the switch and limit zooms (Terrain) and zoom 0.30 (Goods), worst; temporary limit until #485 (planned 4)

parchment_labels_ni_ms.what: parchment: the same on north Italy at the switch and limit zooms (Terrain) and the fit zoom (Goods), worst; temporary limit until #485 (planned 1)

parchment_frame_worst_ms.what: parchment: worst frame panning the made-up Europe in Terrain, Owner and Goods at the switch and limit zooms (Goods also 0.12, 0.28, 0.36, 1.0), 60 countries

parchment_frame_mean_ms.what: parchment: mean of the same (the highest mean of the views)

parchment_band_frame_worst_ms.what: parchment: worst frame of the cross-fade (both pictures drawn): made-up Europe over the far picture, north Italy over the tiles

parchment_mem_mb.what: parchment: meshes and textures on the made-up Europe
